title: Finite evaluation of the ordinary open-system unit
statement: For the Operations o of [def-sf-open-semilinear-tensor-model-data], transport sequence sections through eqToHom o.systemsFunctor.symm and apply o.openSystems.ordinaryAdjunction.unit, defining systemUnit. Assume restrictionEvaluation is the identity on underlying sections. For every sequence module N, finite index n, pro-etale V over X, arrow a from V to the open object and section x of the slice evaluation of N, extensionEvaluation n sends systemUnit(x) to the original finiteExtensionSection(x). The support module also proves horizontal naturality and finite-summand naturality for these explicitly constructed sections.

source.place: Tags 03DI (lemma-extension-by-zero), 03EK (section-tensor-product) and 0E8I (lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor); horizontal compatibility in sites-cohomology.tex, section-inverse-systems, before lemma-derived-limit-is-ok (0941).

proof.text: Apply the recorded unit_evaluation to a section transported through the literal system pushforward. The identity-on-sections restrictionEvaluation assumption removes the intermediate restriction isomorphism. The section specifications of eqToHom and transportEvaluation identify the transported finite section with the given finite pushforward section. Naturality of the localized finite adjunction unit moves this transport through the unit, and localizedSystemAdjunction_existsUnique identifies that unit section with its prescribed direct-sum/sheafification summand, namely finiteExtensionSection. Horizontal compatibility is presheaf naturality of the transport and unit, and finite summand naturality is naturality of the same localized unit. No surjectivity, nonempty-open assumption or change of coefficient level is needed.

theorem systemUnit_evaluation
    (hrestriction : ∀ (n : ℕ) N V x,
      HEq ((((o.openSystems.restrictionEvaluation n).hom.app N).val.app V) x) x)
    (N : coefficientSequenceModules l E U) (n : ℕ) (V : X.ProEt)
    (a : V ⟶ IntegralOpenReduction.openObject j)
    (x : ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E U n).obj N).val.obj
      (op ((IntegralOpenReduction.sliceSite j).obj (Over.mk a)))) :
    ((IntegralOpenReduction.extensionEvaluation l E j o n).hom.app N).val.app (op V)
        (systemUnit l E j o N n (Over.mk a) x) =
      IntegralOpenReduction.finiteExtensionSection l E j o n
        ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E U n).obj N) V a x
